title: Diplomatic Pressure: promissory notes shown as cards
description: Diplomatic Pressure makes the chosen player give one promissory note. The choice listed the raw note ids (cf:Xxcha Kingdom). Now each option is the printed card: its name, the owner, and the card text with the owner named instead of <color>. Before shots are taken on the commit without the change; after shots are regenerated by npm run screenshots -- BV. Synthetic fixture through a mocked server.

shots.heading: Before: desktop
shots.caption: Raw ids such as cf:Xxcha Kingdom and support:Hacan.

shots.heading: After: desktop
shots.caption: Ceasefire, Political Secret and Support for the Throne, each with its owner and printed text.

shots.heading: After: 390x844
shots.caption: The same cards with text on a phone.

notes.title: Where
notes.text: describeCardOption (presentation/cardOptions.ts) recognises the <card>_pick_promissory note subtype and reads name and text from the content catalog; the engine's ids and answers are unchanged.
